questionEn: Which option correctly reveals the meaning of “air”?
questionUz: Qaysi variant "havo" ma'nosini to'g'ri ochib beradi?
choicesEn: A mixture of gases, mainly nitrogen and oxygen
choicesUz: Gazlar aralashmasi, asosan azot va kislorod
explanationEn: Air is a mixture; dry: ≈78% N₂ and ≈21% O₂.
explanationUz: Havo aralashmadir; quruq: ≈78% N₂ va ≈21% O₂.
